title: HVAC and Plumbing in Leon Valley, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in Leon Valley, TX and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: With high summer temperatures and the occasional winter chill, homeowners in Leon Valley, TX rely on dependable HVAC and plumbing systems to keep life running smoothly. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we bring over two decades of experience serving residential and commercial properties with personalized solutions. Our technicians and plumbers are equipped to perform system installations, maintenance, and repairs with honest pricing and trusted results.

As a BBB-accredited, NATE-certified company, and recipient of the 2021 ACCA Residential Contractor of the Year award, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is proud to be a top HVAC professional in the area. We also offer convenient financing options on approved credit, seasonal specials, and maintenance memberships to help keep your home systems running their best year-round.
Full-Service HVAC Experts in Leon Valley

Keeping your home comfortable through the Texas heat and unpredictable cold fronts means having a reliable HVAC system. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we specialize in air conditioning and heating services designed to optimize performance, improve indoor air quality, and reduce your energy bills. Our certified technicians work on all major systems, including heat pumps, ductless mini-splits, and high-efficiency central units. We can provide fast repairs or system replacements depending on your needs.

Routine maintenance is a key part of what we offer, and with our Comfort Club Membership, you get two seasonal tune-ups, priority scheduling, and discounted repair costs. Whether you’re outfitting a brand-new home or extending the life of an aging system, we’re here with reliable support and clear communication every step of the way.
Trusted Plumbing Services That Solve the Problem

At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we focus on fast, effective plumbing solutions. Whether you’re dealing with an emergency leak, a slow drain, or aging pipes, our licensed plumbing team brings advanced tools and detailed expertise. We provide everything from sewer line repairs to water heater upgrades and are happy to recommend energy-saving options like tankless systems or whole-home water treatment solutions.

For homeowners who want to stay ahead of plumbing problems, our annual maintenance program includes critical inspections, pressure tests, and water heater flushing, plus repair discounts throughout the year. We know the value of your time and your home, which is why we show up prepared, work efficiently, and make sure every job is done right the first time.
